              "end_line": 69,
              "is_dynamic": false,
              "raw_text": "EXEC SQL SELECT run_id, status, restart_count,\n                    processed_count, rejected_count, processed_amount\n               INTO :h_bc_run_id, :h_bc_status, :h_bc_restart_count,\n                    :h_bc_processed_count, :h_bc_rejected_count,\n                    :h_bc_processed_amount\n               FROM batch_runs\n              WHERE job_name = :h_bc_job_name\n                AND business_date =\n                    TO_DATE(:h_bc_business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')\n              FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;",
              "project_id": "procsample",
              "project_id_normalized": "procsample",
              "project_name": "procsample",
              "language": "cplus",
              "repo": "/Users/hieplq1.aip/Migration/procsample",

              "name": "INSERT",
              "operation": "INSERT",
              "file_path": "src/core/batch_control.pc",
              "start_line": 75,
              "end_line": 83,
              "is_dynamic": false,
              "raw_text": "EXEC SQL INSERT INTO batch_runs (\n                    run_id, job_name, business_date, status, restart_count,\n                    processed_count, rejected_count, processed_amount,\n                    started_at, updated_at)\n                 VALUES (\n                    seq_batch_runs.NEXTVAL, :h_bc_job_name,\n                    TO_DATE(:h_bc_business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'RUNNING', 0,\n                    0, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)\n                 RETURNING run_id INTO :h_bc_run_id;",
              "project_id": "procsample",
              "project_id_normalized": "procsample",
              "project_name": "procsample",
              "language": "cplus",
              "repo": "/Users/hieplq1.aip/Migration/procsample",

### Description

Intent-aware, multi-strategy Graph Explorer search. Accepts natural language, paragraphs, or vague descriptions (English or Vietnamese). Extracts entities, domain signals, and actions from the query, then fuses semantic vector search + BM25 keyword search + call-graph expansion. Returns explainable ranked nodes with per-node WHY reasons, entry points, related graph paths, and overall confidence score.

### Description

List Qdrant collections.

        Per the unified ingest/query contract:
        - ``project_id`` is optional. When omitted (or empty), returns every
          collection (``None`` semantics = full-search across all projects).
